reply:
Good afternoon Chidi,

Thanks for flagging this. Before resending, I checked the final status of transfer TRF-INV-88 directly with Access Bank, and they confirm the payment was successfully credited to your account (0234567891) on 21 November at 14:02 UTC.

Details for your records:
- Amount: ₦250,000
- Bank: Access Bank
- Account: 0234567891
- Bank session ID: 000014261121140211000088
- Status: Credited to the recipient account

The "failed" status on our side was an error, and the bank has confirmed the money did arrive — so I have not sent a second payment, as that would result in a duplicate ₦250,000.

Please check your account again (including any pending/unsettled balance your bank may display). If you still cannot see the credit after 24 hours, reply here with what your bank shows and we will escalate it with the session ID above as proof of payment.

Apologies for the confusion and thank you for your patience.

Best regards,
Operations Team
Mama's Kitchen
